name: Business setup and PRO services UAE

problems.words: Leads come from ads and WhatsApp, and half never get a reply the same day
quick_ideas: Reply today to every enquiry still waiting, so warm leads aren't lost
Name one person who owns new enquiries each day, so replies stop depending on who looks.

workzap_build.text: one lead inbox for website, ads and WhatsApp with assignment, a reply timer and reminders until contact is made.

problems.ask_first: Where do most of your leads come from?
problems.free_stops: assignment rules and reply timings are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: We spend on Google ads and can't tell which leads became clients
quick_ideas: Ask every new lead where they found you, so you start recording source
Mark the source on this month's won clients once, so you get a first picture.

workzap_build.text: tracked links and codes per ad and channel, so every client shows which campaign brought them.

problems.free_stops: how tracking is set up for your campaigns is kept for the solution document.

problems.words: Quotations are made in Word and every consultant prices differently
quick_ideas: Write one standard price list for your main packages, so quotes start from the same base
Agree who approves discounts, so exceptions are controlled.

workzap_build.text: a quotation builder from your price list and package templates, with an approval step for discounts.

problems.free_stops: package templates and approval rules are designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Clients keep asking "where is my licence?
quick_ideas: Send each active client one update on where their case stands, so the calls ease
Tell new clients once what the main stages are, so they know what to expect.

workzap_build.text: customer_messaging — a case tracker with stages for each service, sending clients a WhatsApp update automatically at each stage.

problems.free_stops: the stages per service and the update flow are worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: Licence and visa expiries slip and clients get fined
quick_ideas: List everything expiring across your managed companies in the next two months, so nothing urgent is missed
Contact those clients this week, so renewals start in time.

workzap_build.text: an expiry calendar for licences, visas, IDs, tenancy registrations and cards across all managed companies, with reminders at several points before each date and renewal quotes drafted automatically.

problems.free_stops: reminder timings and the renewal pipeline are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Government fees we pay don't reconcile with what we billed
quick_ideas: Match last month's government fee payments against client invoices once, so gaps show
Record fees per case from today, so the picture stays clean.

workzap_build.text: a government fee ledger per case, reconciled against client invoices and payments.

problems.free_stops: how fees are recorded and matched is kept for the solution document.

problems.words: We pay government fees upfront and clients pay later
quick_ideas: List the fees you've paid but not yet collected, so the size of the gap is clear
Chase the largest this week, so money comes back.

workzap_build.text: client balances per case with fees advanced, invoices and scheduled reminders.

problems.free_stops: the collection flow is set out in the solution document.

problems.words: PROs run around without a plan and I can't see what they did
quick_ideas: Plan tomorrow's PRO visits on one sheet grouped by location, so trips aren't repeated
Ask PROs for a short end-of-day list of what was done, so you get a record.

workzap_build.text: a PRO day planner grouping visits by location, with check-in and completion notes from phone.

problems.free_stops: the planning rules and check-in flow are worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: Consultants keep client files on their laptops, and clients leave when they resign
quick_ideas: Move active case files into one shared firm folder, so they stay with the firm
Name a backup consultant per large client, so relationships aren't single-threaded.

workzap_build.text: a client file vault and case history with access by role, so every case stays with the firm.

problems.free_stops: access roles and file structure are kept for the solution document.

never_say: Any immigration, visa, licensing, legal, corporate tax, VAT or banking advice, or which structure or jurisdiction a client should choose. Anything involving nominee arrangements to hide ownership, shell companies for concealment, fake tenancy or employment, visa selling or bribery. That approvals or licences will be issued by a certain date. Requests for client IDs, passports, licence numbers or bank details.

sample_reply.person: We manage renewals for a lot of companies and every month a few slip and the client gets fined. What can we do?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be brought under control, starting this week. 1 List everything expiring across your managed companies in the next two months, so nothing urgent is missed. 2 Contact those clients this week, so renewals start in time. Workzap can do this automatically for you: an expiry calendar across every company you manage, with reminders to your team and the client well before each date. Would you like me to put together a solution document and quote for you? You're free to say no.
